report.costSummaryNote: Configured-rate estimate, not a charging invoice
report.summarySource: Recorded drive details · comparisons use this vehicle’s history
report.sectionUnavailable: No {{section}} data is available for this drive.
report.sampleStatistics: Sample statistics · arithmetic means, not time-weighted drive aggregates
report.aggregateSource: Drive aggregates · comparisons use this vehicle’s history
report.consumptionEstimate: Consumption uses estimated energy; see energy evidence for assumptions.
report.energyEstimate: Estimate: absolute average power × duration; not metered energy
report.regenEstimate: Estimate: negative-power sample mean × duration; assumes uniform sampling
report.rangeSource: First/last available ideal range; rated range is the fallback
report.rangeDelta: Difference of available range estimates, not distance travelled
report.batteryDelta: Endpoint SOC difference, not a measured energy total
report.noNet: Consumed and recovered energy retain their original source semantics. No additional net-energy total is inferred.
report.costMethod: Estimate using configured rates, not a charging invoice. Energy source is listed in energy evidence.
report.powerMethod: Power samples preserve sign: positive draw, negative regeneration. Peak values require observations.
report.regenRatioMethod: Recovered / (consumed + recovered), using drive-summary energy sources. This ratio is not a metered braking-efficiency measurement.
report.rangeSeriesSource: First/last recorded values of this range estimator; gaps are not zero

road.title: Possible road-surface anomalies
road.subtitle: Historical telemetry review — not confirmed potholes
road.caveat: Tesla does not report vertical impact or suspension motion. A candidate may be a road seam, speed bump, or maneuver; no candidate does not prove the road was smooth.
road.insufficient: This drive did not record sufficiently close acceleration, speed, and GPS observations to screen for short jolts. Missing evidence is not a smooth-road result.
road.none: No short jolt matched the screening criteria in the usable telemetry. Events between reports may have been missed.

driveDetail.title: Drive details

debrief.title: Post-drive physics
debrief.subtitle: One story after the drive: launch vs regen vs pads vs thermal vs FSD km. Not more gauges.
debrief.launch: Launch load showed up on the inverter. This is peak power, not a 0–60 claim.
debrief.regen: Regen harvested energy back into the pack. One-pedal is not blended pads.
debrief.blended: Friction-pad blend is not in this telemetry. Missing, not zero.
debrief.thermal: Stator derate was not measured on this drive. Missing, not cool.
debrief.fsd: Supervised-driving km come from the trip meter, not engagement segments.
debrief.gap: This drive has no power samples. The story would be fanfic.

driveDetail.noTelemetryTitle: No telemetry recorded for this drive
driveDetail.noTelemetryBody: Only the start/end timestamps and battery levels are available. Distance, speed, energy and route data require live telemetry samples — none were captured during this drive.
driveDetail.noRouteData: No route data available for this drive
driveDetail.noTemperatureData: No temperature telemetry is available for this drive.

silent.title: Counter silent while moving
silent.unknown: The FSD trip meter did not report on this drive. Absence is not a disengagement.

aiCoaching.title: Drive coaching
aiCoaching.description: Get a 2-4 paragraph plain-language coaching summary of this drive — efficiency, regen use, and notable braking or acceleration moments — generated from the same per-drive metrics shown above.

aiSpeedProfile.title: Speed-profile insights
aiSpeedProfile.description: Get a short plain-language interpretation of this drive’s speed regime distribution — city / suburban / highway buckets, outliers, and how the speed envelope compares to a typical drive — generated from the same per-drive aggregates shown in the chart.

fsmEmpty.title: No transitions in window
fsmEmpty.message: No FSM state changes recorded near the drive end. Try a wider window.

whyEnded.signalEmpty: No signals in this window for the default whitelist.

ledger.title: Energy ledger
ledger.massMissing: Vehicle mass is not configured. Mass-dependent estimates require TESLASYNC_VEHICLE_MASS_KG, which applies to every vehicle in this installation.
ledger.elevationMissing: Grade and friction-brake estimates require recorded elevation; this telemetry source does not provide it.
ledger.hvacMissing: Tesla reports HVAC on/off state, not power in watts. Accessory energy and the complete unexplained residual cannot be calculated from that state.

brief.batteryEndpoints: Recorded battery endpoints: {{start}}% → {{end}}%; an absent endpoint remains unknown.
brief.odometerSource: Odometer endpoints use {{source}} evidence; missing endpoints are not zero.
brief.batteryRateBasis: Recorded battery percentage-point change divided by positive measured distance, per 100 {{unit}}.
